description: Homematic IP switch actuator with integrated power measurement for brand switch systems. This profile only models the switch's self-consumption because the connected load is measured by the device.
measure_description: Measured repeatedly using Powercalc average mode for 300 seconds with a 7.7W dummy load, then averaged. No difference was measured between the on and off standby power.
name: Switching Actuator and Meter for Brand Switches
